title: Shared logical-layout semantics across SVG and Pixi
summary: Centralized hardware semantics so CPU and GPU rendering modes present consistent topology and interactions.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-06-22. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Rebuilt logical layout around shared hardware classification and metadata, with route-aware grouping for complex interconnect structures.
Centralized labels, colors, visibility, cursors and interaction behavior across SVG and Pixi rendering backends, with focused layout and renderer coverage.
Resolved logical-canvas connectivity and export/re-import defects involving ingress resolution, route highlights and persisted backing connections.
Repaired route, CAL and grouped-node connectivity presentation and export/re-import behavior while preserving backend connection and placement semantics.

Current shared input and renderer infrastructure includes substantive contributions by multiple engineers; Michael authored selected metadata, classification and persistence changes rather than the entire shared architecture.

notes: Other engineers contributed shared scene and renderer architecture; this record describes Michael's documented changes.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
An unsupported acronym expansion in the draft Git findings was corrected to grouped-node connectivity; the immutable earlier wording is superseded by the final semantic review.
